CHAPTER.VERS: Praise YAH! Praise the Mighty God in His sanctuary; praise Him in His mighty firmament!
Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him according to His excellent greatness!
Praise Him with the sound of the shofar; praise Him with the lute and harp!
Praise Him with the timbrel and dance; praise Him with stringed instruments and pipes!
Praise Him with sounding cymbals; praise Him with loud cymbals!
Let everything that has breath praise YAH. Praise YAH!
